author: Synthetic Generator
content:
Space Exploration Technologies Corp. (NASDAQ:SPCX) has finalized a $40 billion financing for Nvidia Corp. (NASDAQ:NVDA) chips, according to people familiar with the matter, with Apollo Global Management (NYSE:APO) leading the package.

Pacific Investment Management Co. has formally committed to the investment-grade portion of the debt. Ives said the closing date has been moved up to the first quarter of 2027.

In a Friday research note, Ives raised his price target to $240 from $225, citing the finalized financing and expanded Colossus 2 capacity. He kept his Outperform rating.

SPCX shares rose about 3% on the news to close at $172.40. The stock is still well below its 52-week high of $225.64.
headline: SpaceX Finalizes $40 Billion Nvidia Chip Financing; Ives Raises Target to $240
summary: SpaceX has finalized its $40 billion Apollo-led chip financing, Pacific Investment Management committed, and Dan Ives raised his target to $240.
